result.detail: Each customer can self-generate API key in Copper web app (System settings > API Keys), no vendor gate. Docs state no install/user cap and no marketplace review. Caveat: the OAuth 2.0 path (preferred for partner integrations) needs app registration by contacting Copper partners. Docs describe no review criteria or caps, so per-customer API keys count as none.
result.quote: To generate an API token, in the Copper web app go to System settings > API Keys and click the 'GENERATE API KEY' button.
